propositions: Every typed configuration key emitted through _SECTION_CLASSES must have a nonempty public_description metadata field co-located with the dataclass field definition.
The configuration reference generator must require and enforce nonempty description metadata, failing generation with the offending key named when metadata is missing or empty.
Each generated Description cell in docs/config-reference.md must state a user-visible effect or operational consequence distinct from its Key, Type, Default, and Lifecycle cells.
The configuration schema module src/rebar/_config_schema.py must remain below the 800-line absolute limit; low-level validation logic must be extracted or moved to existing modules as needed.
All typed field annotations, default values, default factories, configuration coercion, and runtime behavior must remain unchanged after adding public descriptions.
